independentImplementationAcceptance.name: Evidence-backed names
independentImplementationAcceptance.procedure: Expose47 XML slot names and7 XML transition names with stable independent IDs/provenance. Keep8 additional localized effect and26 transition labels provisional; exclude Empty and ---TEXT--- from effect totals.
independentImplementationAcceptance.expected: No invented names;55/33 remains candidate-name union, not confirmed active menus.

independentImplementationAcceptance.name: Actual independent rendering
independentImplementationAcceptance.procedure: Use moving asymmetric color bars/checkerboards/frame numbers through real Canvas/WebGL. For each enabled effect capture bypass and at least3 distinct parameter states, toggle off and switch effects.
independentImplementationAcceptance.expected: Intended pixels change, bypass restores input, amount changes matter, old temporal state releases. Metadata-only entries unavailable. This is not Serato visual equivalence.

independentImplementationAcceptance.name: Slot routing
independentImplementationAcceptance.procedure: Implement two distinct effect slots on each left/right channel plus two dedicated master slots (six positions). Apply effects separately; test channel isolation, each slot selection/on-off/parameter, and noncommuting processor order.
independentImplementationAcceptance.expected: Six independently controlled positions with documented provenance. Publish original processing order; exact reference order, live routing and simultaneous hardware behavior remain unverified.

independentImplementationAcceptance.name: Transitions
independentImplementationAcceptance.procedure: For each original transition sample minimum, near-minimum, midpoint, near-maximum and maximum crossfader positions in both directions plus channel upfaders.
independentImplementationAcceptance.expected: Document a distinct independent contract per family; do not assume conventional A/B endpoints for additive/difference/upfaders-only/latch/grid transitions. Exact reference contour/speed unknown.

independentImplementationAcceptance.name: Auto selection
independentImplementationAcceptance.procedure: Load clips with Auto off/on; exercise explicit Next and seeded Random selection at qualifying track loads.
independentImplementationAcceptance.expected: Auto retains versus changes selected transition as declared; do not conflate legacy auto-selection with automatic crossfader motion.4.0.10 confirmation open.

independentImplementationAcceptance.name: Reactive inputs
independentImplementationAcceptance.procedure: Use silence,bass-only,treble-only,known-BPM and forward/reverse fixtures per deck for any advertised audio/BPM/record-reactive processor.
independentImplementationAcceptance.expected: Input dependence follows an explicit original contract. Do not fabricate RGB/CSL/TTM57SL control bindings or equate31 hidden audio-linked names with visible slot catalog.

independentImplementationAcceptance.name: Overlays
independentImplementationAcceptance.procedure: Create/save/reload/edit/toggle overlays; four Scroll directions at3 speeds; BPM/Bass Zoom at3 intensities with explicit L/R context. Test opacity separately for text and image using partially overlapping fixtures.
independentImplementationAcceptance.expected: Public documented state lifecycle and target restrictions; no claim of master-only reactive zoom.

independentImplementationAcceptance.name: Reference parity gate
independentImplementationAcceptance.procedure: With explicit authorization for later installed-runtime inspection, enumerate current menus and ranges on4.0.10.213 and compare synthetic pixel/timing fixtures.
independentImplementationAcceptance.expected: No1:1, full active-catalog, native or physical-output claim before that evidence.
